body: Context: the plan was to turn github.com/ubgo/dotenv into a deprecated forwarder (type aliases over textdata/dotenv). Chosen (owner, 2026-11-13): no forwarder. At release: (1) release textdata, (2) switch cfgkit's root module import from github.com/ubgo/dotenv to github.com/ubgo/textdata/dotenv, (3) final ubgo/dotenv commit with a moved-to-textdata README banner and '// Deprecated: use github.com/ubgo/textdata/dotenv' in go.mod and cli/go.mod, tag v0.1.2 (cli/v0.1.4), then archive the repo. Alternative rejected: the alias forwarder (local branch textdata-forwarder, kept only as a reference; remote branch deleted). Reasoning: the only known importer is our own cfgkit; old tags stay downloadable so nothing breaks; one real copy of the code instead of a second module to maintain. task forwarder:check removed.
title: No ubgo/dotenv forwarder; deprecate and archive the old repo instead
